messages:
anya: Quick RFC follow-up. We agreed on precision lanes last week, but we still lack enforcement + migration for the old per-layer packer. Need a concrete plan for owners and tooling.

matt: I can own the migration tooling. Proposal: a small CLI `probecli` that runs a lightweight probe suite and emits perf/quality deltas.

sasha: Important: the runtime API surface must be small. I don't want new top-level config fields per model. Add a single `precision_lane` string on serve-config, with optional `route_overrides`.

omar: Data point: aggressive 4-bit gave 22% cost reduction on batch workloads but some customers saw >1% EM drop on long-form QA. So lane semantics need explicit guarantees.

anya: Lane definitions (draft):
- safe: conservative quant (int8 or per-layer heuristics), auto-fallback on regression, no opt-in for hosted free tier.
- standard: balanced latency/cost, default for hosted paid tiers.
- experimental: best perf/cost, opt-in only for Dedicated and e2e tests.

matt: For `probecli` MVP output I envision a minimal JSON:
```
{
  "lane": "standard-v1",
  "delta_p95_ms": -9,
  "relative_em": 0.006,
  "status": "risk-flag",
  "notes": "drop concentrated on long-concat prompts"
}
```

anka: (typo correction) s/anka/anya :grimacing:

sasha: We need a formal "behavioral-diff budget" per lane. Suggest default budgets: safe=0.002, standard=0.005, experimental=0.02 (relative EM). Any change above budget requires manual review.

omar: Ops checklist for deprecating old per-layer API:
- 60-day announce + examples for mapping old configs into lanes
- `probecli` migrate mode that prints mapping and expected delta (dry-run)
- canary rollout plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback hook if probe metrics or live evals degrade beyond lane budget
- store deterministic seeds + model checksum in every canary metadata bundle for reproducibility

matt: Mechanically, runtime will consume `precision_lane` and resolve to a named quant profile artifact (e.g., `standard-v1-int8pack-2026-02-12`). This keeps serve-config simple.

sasha: API naming nit: please call the field `precision_lane`, not `bit_profile`. Lane implies policy and runtime mapping. Also add `route_overrides` as a map in the docs (customers can pin certain routes to safe).

anya: For hosted defaults: standard for normal routes, safe for routes that use `sensitive=true` metadata, experimental hidden behind tenant flag for Dedicated.

omar: Telemetry: record per-request `lane_id`, `profile_artifact`, `delta_probe_score` (from probecli), and `canary_tag`. Also expose a histogram of per-token perplexity change for post-hoc analysis.

matt: I will land `probecli` prototype this week. Basic commands: `probecli analyze --model <id> --lane standard-v1`, `probecli migrate --from-old-config path --to-lane standard-v1 --dry-run`.

sasha: Governance: set up an automated checklist that gates lane publication: unit tests, a golden-eval run, probecli pass, docs + migration notes, and product signoff for experimental lanes.

omar: For rollbacks: runtime must be able to revert on a per-node basis. Add `auto_fallback_on_regression` boolean in the profile artifact metadata (not the user config). Default true for safe, false for experimental.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `standard-v1` on staging (2/4 nodes) — monitoring OK so far

anya: Next actions:
- matt: `probecli` MVP + README (ETA 5d)
- sasha: draft governance checklist + docs wording for `precision_lane` (ETA 3d)
- omar: ops playbook for canary + rollback scripts (ETA 7d)

anya: I'll post this summary to #eng-releases once `probecli` lands. Good progress, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
